title: Standard Doubler Family for Lower Shell Impact Findings Below the Belly Fairing
abstract: Introduces a pre-qualified family of doubler sizes and a common fastener pattern for ground impact damage below the belly fairing, replacing the case by case repair approvals that were consuming design office time on routine findings.

sections.reason: Ground handling impact below the belly fairing generates roughly ninety repair approval requests a year across the fleet, of which four out of five are dents and scratches within a narrow size band. Each one was being answered individually, taking between two and nine days, and operators were holding aircraft for a reply that in most cases produced the same answer. The design office review concluded that a pre-qualified family would cover eighty-two per cent of the historical population.
sections.description: Four doubler sizes are defined and substantiated for the lower shell panels below the belly fairing, each with a single fastener pattern, edge distance rule and surface preparation. The doubler blanks, the associated cleat and the gusset for the two larger sizes are released as spares and stocked at the main line stations. The structure repair manual is extended with the selection chart, the damage limits that admit the family, and the cases that still require design office approval. The delivered configuration is unchanged; production embodies the change only in that the panel identification stencil now carries the family reference so that a line engineer can find the chart quickly.
sections.effects: Mass effect is per repair rather than per aircraft, between one and four kilograms depending on size. No electrical or dispatch effect. Interchangeability is not applicable. The structure repair manual and the damage investigation inspection task both require reissue. The main benefit is turn time: an in-limit finding can now be dispositioned by the operator without a request.
sections.embodiment_note: Production embodiment from MSN M00435 is documentation and stencilling only. The bulletin releases the family to the in-service fleet and requires no work on the aircraft until a finding occurs.

type_data.balance_impact: Not applicable, mass depends on the repair actually embodied
type_data.production_impact: Stencilling change only from MSN M00435
